text:
maya: Quick sync — I want to roll ff:route_v2 to 5% as a canary next Tue (15:00 UTC). Two asks: confirm audience overlap exclusions (sales experiments + internal cohorts) and agree on early-stop thresholds for rerank CTR and latency.

sam: tagging eng-experiments + eng-sre. Which audience set are you planning to use? Do we have a bucketing seed update?

jess: Use the existing audience set `canary_small_v3` if that works. It already excludes most internal groups but not sales_cohort by default. Bucketing is deterministic (user_id % 10000). If you need extra exclusions, add them in the flag filter.

jess: ```yaml
flag: route_v2
audience:
  include: canary_small_v3
  exclude: [big_ui, qa_group, internal_beta, sales_cohort]
percent: 5
stop_rules:
  - metric: response_time_p95
    direction: up
    threshold: +200ms
  - metric: rerank_ctr
    direction: down
    threshold: -3%
```

liam: Two practical notes: 1) metrics are computed only on traffic that actually saw route_v2 (so ensure instrumentation is on). 2) rare cohorts may have noisy CTRs — consider a minimum sample size check for stop rules.

maya: Good point on sample size. For conservative rollout, I'm thinking add an early-stop that triggers on -1.5% CTR drop sustained for 30m with p < 0.05, and the existing +200ms p95 latency rule. Thoughts?

sam: Fine by me. Also, @deploy-bot can you validate infra capacity for Tue 15:00 UTC for a 5% ramp? Need to make sure we won't hit autoscale thundering.

deploy-bot: capacity check: no reserved GPUs required for 5% canary at Tue 15:00 UTC. Autoscaling headroom looks healthy in eu-west1/us-central. I can add a scheduled note to the deployment calendar if you add the runbook link.

jess: I recommend adding a metric guard that requires >= 2k impressions per cohort window before stop rules evaluate. That will reduce false positives.

maya: I'll update the flag YAML with the exclusions and add the sample-size guard + the conservative early-stop. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-route_v2 . Plan: Tue 15:00 UTC rollout, 5% -> monitor 30m -> 25% if stable. Anyone object?

liam: No objections. +1 :thumbsup:

sam: +1. I'll be on-call 15:00-16:00 UTC for this rollout.

maya: thanks all — I'll push the flag change and link the runbook in the Console. If anything flags, we'll rollback to 0% immediately.
